author: National Geographic
description:
On the anniversary of the discovery of King Tutankhamun's tomb in the Valley of Kings in 1922, this National Geographic special takes a look back at the iconic discovery, revealing it for the first time in color, thanks to colorization of black-and-white newsreel and photographs.

King Tut in Color | Special

07:21 - Hunt for Tutankhamun
13:49 - Breakthrough Discovery

26:11 - Global Tut-Mania & The Pharaoh's Curse
29:16 - Unlocking the Burial Chamber & Royal Shrines
37:11 - Opening the Solid Gold Coffin
42:19 - Revealing the Golden Mask
